title: Tuesday's boring SaaS, 13 October 2026
dek: Tuesday, 13 October 2026. Seven are Stripe-verified. IK-Generator runs on Paddle. Francopass and Steady are RevenueCat-verified.

companies.name: IK-Generator
companies.description: Automates French professional mileage allowances: routes, official 2026 scale, Excel export for accounting/tax. Founded Mar 2025, France. Solo. ~80 users (founder-stated). Listed for sale (codebase, domain, SEO site, GA + Paddle). Pricing: €99/year per account via Paddle.
companies.evidence: ~$689 MRR, 75 active subscriptions, ~$111 L30, ~$12,707 all-time. Founder-stated ~$9k L12 / 94% margin. Revenue synced Oct 13, 2026 ~05:50 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Wrap one country's statutory calculator, sell the PDF/Excel, then flip or expand to the next barème.
companies.whyItPrints: Every FR self-employed driver, sales rep, and agent still owes a barème spreadsheet. One annual tax chore × SEO = quiet recurring cash with ~94% margin (founder-stated).

companies.name: Legal Tech
companies.description: Cloud practice management for attorneys and legal depts: case files, deadlines, court/registry lookups (ЕПЕП, Търговски регистър), document generation, billing. Founded Oct 2025, Bulgaria. Pricing: Solo €19/mo, Standard €49/mo, Pro €79/mo (company-stated; yearly −20%).
companies.evidence: ~$16,814 MRR, 98 active subscriptions, ~$2,051 L30, ~$15,742 all-time. L30 cash is far below listed MRR (likely annual prepaid / renewals clustered — treat MRR as Stripe's subscription metric, L30 as cash). Revenue synced Oct 13, 2026 ~03:48 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Pick one country's lawyer bureaucracy stack; integrations beat feature lists.
companies.whyItPrints: Local court + company-registry integrations are the moat. Generic Notion/CRM does not talk to Bulgarian e-justice.

companies.name: Funneled
companies.description: No-code Shopify landing pages / advertorials for cold paid traffic: cart sync, split tests, Meta/TikTok tracking. Founded Apr 2025, Australia. Pricing: Starter $349/mo, Growth $699/mo, Performance custom (company-stated).
companies.evidence: ~$18,034 MRR, 21 active subscriptions, ~$19,154 L30, ~$94,651 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 13, 2026 ~04:19 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Sell the missing page between ad click and Shopify checkout — price for agencies, not hobby stores.
companies.whyItPrints: Performance marketers will pay mid-three-figures seats when ad creative needs matching landers. High ARPU, few accounts.

companies.name: WriteStack
companies.description: Scheduling, analytics, and publishing helpers for Substack writers/Notes. Founded Jul 2024, US. Solo founder (Orel).
companies.evidence: ~$12,984 MRR, 486 active subscriptions, ~$15,096 L30, ~$175,667 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 13, 2026 ~02:09 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Own one platform's missing workflow (Notes scheduler / analytics) instead of another generic social suite.
companies.whyItPrints: Substack's built-in tools leave gaps; a focused layer on a growing creator platform collects hundreds of small monthly seats.

companies.name: Francopass
companies.description: iOS / Android / web prep for the French civic exam and naturalization interview: quiz, flashcards, audio, AI mock interview. Founded Oct 2025, France. ~14k users prepared (company-stated). Listed for sale. Pricing from €4.99 after free demo.
companies.evidence: ~$1,675 MRR, 132 active subscriptions, ~$3,729 L30. Tracked since 6 Mar 2026. Revenue synced Oct 13, 2026 ~04:11 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Country + one high-stakes exam. Same playbook for DE/IT/ES naturalization or driving theory.
companies.whyItPrints: Immigration paperwork is evergreen, localized, and emotional — people pay to not fail the prefecture interview.

companies.name: InflateMate
companies.description: Booking site, live inventory, deposits, waivers, delivery pricing for inflatable rental operators. Founded Feb 2025, US. Starter $49/mo, Growth $99/mo. Company-stated: 48 rental businesses, $75k+ online rental payments recorded, 458 bookings, 343 waivers.
companies.evidence: ~$1,480 MRR, 19 active subscriptions, ~$1,486 L30, ~$7,343 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 13, 2026 ~06:11 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Pick one rental niche (bounce houses, tents, porta-potties) and ship booking + waiver + Stripe deposits.
companies.whyItPrints: Weekend double-booking and paper waivers are real money leaks. Vertical PMS for a trade nobody on HN talks about.

companies.name: Steady — Fear of Flying
companies.description: Offline pocket co-pilot for anxious flyers with route turbulence forecast, calming tools, community. Founded Jun 2026. Pricing: Pro weekly $5.99, Bravery Pass 72h $11.99, yearly $39.99, lifetime $49.99. App Store rating 4.7/5 (25 ratings at sync).
companies.evidence: ~$3,447 MRR, 227 active subscriptions, ~$4,919 L30, ~$23,651 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 13, 2026 ~05:00 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Pair a scary real-world anxiety with one measurable data feed (turbulence), then upsell trip packs.
companies.whyItPrints: Fear-of-flying is a sticky consumer niche with clear willingness to pay around trip days; turbulence-as-a-feature is concrete.
companies.imageAlt: Steady — Fear of Flying product image

companies.name: Databuddy
companies.description: Cookie-less, no-fingerprint analytics: visits, events, errors, funnels; open source. Founded Jun 2025, US. Free 10k events; Hobby $9.99/mo; Pro $49.99/mo.
companies.evidence: ~$2,846 MRR, 32 active subscriptions, ~$5,316 L30, ~$10,456 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 13, 2026 ~02:07 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Differentiate on investigation UX ("what changed / what to do") rather than another GA clone.
companies.whyItPrints: GDPR-tired sites still need charts. Privacy analytics is crowded but Stripe-verified seats prove buyers keep showing up.

companies.name: Ship Restrict
companies.description: Blocks regulated SKUs from restricted US states / cities / ZIPs on Shopify & WooCommerce. Founded Apr 2025, US. Solo. Woo $29.99/mo, Shopify $19.99/mo. Founder notes Shopify billing is not in TrustMRR totals (no Shopify Payments sync).
companies.evidence: ~$210 MRR, 8 active subscriptions, ~$150 L30, ~$2,549 all-time. Shopify app revenue excluded from these figures. Revenue synced Oct 13, 2026 ~03:38 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Encode one messy regulation table as a checkout gate; sell on both Shopify and Woo.
companies.whyItPrints: One compliance rule engine saves merchants from illegal shipments. Classic plugin-tax on regulated e-com.

companies.name: Tifox
companies.description: Digital pupil progress booklet for French maternelle teachers against the official 2026 curriculum: photos, offline, print-ready PDF for families. Android / iOS / web. Founded Mar 2026, France. Solo. Annual €12–€25 per class; free up to 3 pupils. ~1,432 users (company-stated). Seasonal (peaks Jun–Sep).
companies.evidence: ~$106 MRR, 57 active subscriptions, ~$1,586 L30, ~$4,170 all-time. L30 is well above MRR, which fits annual back-to-school billing. Revenue synced Oct 13, 2026 ~06:12 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Digitize one country's required school form; price per class; sell town halls next.
companies.whyItPrints: Mandatory school paperwork + official curriculum versioning = recurring September renewals. Town-hall group licences are the expansion path.
